environment.description: Flask application deployed on EC2 instance running as root user. The /var/app/tenant_data directory has no filesystem-level isolation. PostgreSQL database has RLS policies on tenant_files table but the zip extraction writes directly to the filesystem. The application process has write access to the entire filesystem including /etc/cron.d, /var/spool/cron, and other sensitive paths. No containerization or filesystem sandboxing is applied.
